title: Halo
subtitle: Not According to Plan
text:
Support (When you play this unit, you may attack with another unit. It gains this unit's other abilities for this attack.)
When Attack Ends: If the defending unit was defeated, give a Shield token to this unit.
rules: When Attack Ends abilities trigger at the same time as units deal combat damage. If the defending unit was defeated, give a Shield token to the attacking unit.
